messages:
Mina: Quick follow-up from the Cerulean private deployment postmortem. Summary: replicate-heavy burst triggered asymmetric VPC peering flaps and exposed a routing cleanup double-delete that led to short tenant isolation. Need clear owners, tracker links, and a customer verification window.
Ravi: I'll own the peering stabilization work. Plan: audit BGP timers, add soft-restart/hold-time tuning, and add a flaky-network integration test. Creating tracker now.
Priya: I'll take security/compliance review for any edge changes (KMS/HSM interactions + config defaults). Want the patch + config diff before rollout.
Sarah: I'll own connector resilience (circuit-breaker restart, backoff tuning, and e2e fault injection that kills the agent). ETA 7 business days. Will open tracker.
Diego: I'll triage the routing cleanup double-delete (state-machine race) and add a CAS + idempotency checks in the integration harness. ETA 3 days.
Ravi: Ticket INF-3450 created: peering stabilization + flaky-net tests https://tracker.redwoodai/INF-3450
Sarah: Ticket INF-3451 created: connector circuit-breaker + fault-injection e2e https://tracker.redwoodai/INF-3451
Diego: Ticket INF-3452 created: routing cleanup CAS fix + regression harness https://tracker.redwoodai/INF-3452
Priya: Created INF-3455 for security review & KMS audit: https://tracker.redwoodai/INF-3455
Luke: Ops ticket INF-3453 created: asymmetric-peering canary + isolation-heatmap dashboard https://tracker.redwoodai/INF-3453. I'll wire alerts and a runbook entry.
Mina: Condensed action items:
- Ravi (INF-3450): BGP hold-time, soft-restart, flaky-net injection
- Sarah (INF-3451): circuit-breaker restart, backoff defaults, e2e crash test
- Diego (INF-3452): CAS on cleanup, race regression
- Priya (INF-3455): security review, KMS/audit
- Luke (INF-3453): canary + isolation incident heatmap
- Laura: perf synthetic for replicate-heavy profile (INF-3454)
Laura: INF-3454 created: replicate-heavy synthetic for dedicated perf harness https://tracker.redwoodai/INF-3454. ETA 10 days.
Mina: Timeline suggestion (staggered): Diego 3d, Luke 3d, Sarah 7bd, Priya review by security within 2bd of PR, Ravi 14d. Proposed private customer verification window: Thu 03:00-04:00 UTC. Anyone object?
Diego: Repro logs from the harness:
```
W 2025-11-12T02:12:07Z router[tenant=cerulean-17]: cleanup: delete(key=route-42)
I 2025-11-12T02:12:07Z router[tenant=cerulean-17]: enqueued cleanup retry
E 2025-11-12T02:12:07Z router[tenant=cerulean-17]: double-delete detected, state mismatch
```
Diego: Plan: add compare-and-swap on delete path and assert no-op on missing key. Will add an integration that races two cleanup messages.
Sarah: Connector detail: will add a circuit-breaker that opens after X failures (configurable), exponential backoff with jitter, and a smoke that kills the agent container for 20s to ensure auto-rejoin within SLA.
Priya: Security checks: please attach the config diff and explain any new runtime flags. I'll run a quick KMS audit and ensure no change to customer key usage. Also request a short threat-model note for public clouds vs on-prem.
Luke: Ops-bot reminder: weekly "isolation trends" triage set for #incidents at Mondays 09:00 UTC. I'll post the initial heatmap snapshot in that channel.
Ops-bot: Reminder set for #incidents: weekly 09:00 UTC — "Isolation trends triage"
Mina: Perf + Ops: once Laura adds the synthetic and Luke wires the canary, let's run the verification replay before customer window. Priya: security please sign off on the patch no later than 24h before verification.
Ravi: I'll draft the customer addendum after INF-3452 lands to schedule the verification window and include rollback instructions.
Mina: OK — add these tickets to the Dedicated/Postmortem board and paste PR links, changelog, and verification notes here as they land. Closing thread for now. Thanks all :tada:
